title: Criminal courts and their sentencing powers — ss. 6, 9, 31–34 CrPC

children.title: Courts of Session
children.sub: SJ / ASJ — any sentence (death confirmed); Asst SJ — up to 7 years

children.title: Courts of Magistrates
children.sub: s. 30 Magistrate — up to 7 years, offences not punishable with death

steps.title: Summons
steps.text: Written, signed, sealed; personal service, adult male member of family, or affixation

steps.title: Warrant of arrest
steps.text: In lieu of or in addition to summons, for reasons recorded; may be bailable (endorsed)

steps.title: Proclamation
steps.text: After a warrant and evidence of abscondence; at least 30 days; read, affixed at house and court-house

steps.title: Attachment
steps.text: Movable or immovable property; claims within 6 months; sale after 6 months

steps.title: Restoration / evidence in absence
steps.text: Restore within 2 years if no abscondence and no notice (appeal — s. 405); depositions under s. 512

steps.title: FIR
steps.text: Cognizable offence — written, read over, signed; women's provisos

steps.title: Report to Magistrate; to the spot
Statements and confessions
steps.text: s. 161 by police (not signed; contradiction only); s. 164 by Magistrate

steps.title: Arrest, 24 hours, remand
steps.text: Physical remand up to 15 days in all; women — not except qatl / dacoity

steps.title: Police report (challan)
steps.text: Through the Public Prosecutor; interim report after 14 days; or cancellation report

title: A trial before the Court of Session — Chapter XXII-A

steps.title: Copies to the accused
steps.text: FIR, police report, ss. 161 / 164 statements, inspection and recovery notes — 7 days before

steps.title: Charge and plea
steps.text: Charge framed if ground to proceed; read and explained; plea recorded

steps.title: Statement of the accused
steps.text: Every incriminating circumstance put; optional evidence on oath

steps.title: Judgment
steps.text: Acquittal or conviction; acquittal possible at any stage (s. 265K); death sentence to High Court

rootSub: bail ends on cancellation, forfeiture, conviction, acquittal, discharge of sureties or death
